propositions: Documentation across four reader-facing locations (gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and packaged author guide) lacks a complete tri-state contract for file-impact scope (undeclared, paths, none).
The tri-state behavior is already landed in src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py with specific replacement and clearing semantics for each state.
Public runtime entry point `rebar explain plan` does not communicate the none command, tri-state choices, or advisory no-file-impact LLM criterion to users authoring plans.

Standalone documentation must define freshness scope (whole-HEAD vs dependency-scoped), container roll-up behavior (neutral, poison, exclusion), material-fingerprint effects, and working examples of mixed paths-plus-none declarations.
Verification requires both a behavioral test of the public CLI contract and a durable semantic checklist of standalone doc criteria, not source-grep or snapshot tests.
